IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mock, inspiration and not literal. Real figures of 2026-10-01 (the altseason panel, the hot sectors, the picks and their Degen levels), as they would read with the proposed seventh gate, Dilution (item 25).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dilution takes the place of Theme wind: Pharaoh Exchange, up and nest (7.2%, 9.3%, 4.6% of market cap a week) drop out: 11 picks become 8, the picks by upside start with Collector Crypt. Grey chip: dilution unknown, not a fault, stays a pick.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only the number of all apps and the number of picks are written in the gate row; the cubes before each gate are only a picture. Logos are left out, coin icons are letters.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The hovered gate (7) shows the tooltip every gate would have; it floats over the page and moves nothing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The one literal part of this picture is the row of the seven gates: the owner wants it built to look exactly like this.
